cases.title: Ticket created without a SKU (DWP / API) gets its SKU from Categorization Tier 1
cases.pre: A catalog item whose Subcategory matches exactly one Tier 1 value (record which one).
cases.data: Incident submitted through DWP or the REST API with Tier 1 set and no Service SKU
steps: Submit an Incident for UAT Customer01 through DWP (or REST API) with Categorization Tier 1 = the matching value and no Service SKU.
Open the Incident in Helix.
exp: Service SKU is filled with the matching catalog item.
Billing Type, rate and expenditure codes are filled from that item without anyone opening the form.
cases.actual: ACCEPTED AS KNOWN GAP - not executed (decision N. Foy 10/20 21:40). Recheck 10/20: Rockefeller incidents use only three Tier 1 values (Break Fix 75, Test ITOC1_RF 30, Test IT_RF 1 in a sample of 150 of 196) and none of the 230 catalog Subcategories equals any of them, so NN:HPD:CGB_SKU_010_FallbackFromTier1 (and the WOI copy) never matches. The filter is kept (order 0, runs before the default) but is inactive for Rockefeller data. The real fallback for a ticket with no Service SKU is DEF-064: NN:HPD:CGB_SKU_016_DefaultSKU sets CGBDEFAULT (Hourly, 85.00, 63719/54101), verified on INC000000167377. If a Tier 1 to catalog mapping is wanted later, it is a design change (different field or a mapping table). Earlier notes: ~80 SKUs exist twice in NN:CGB:Service (e.g. 13354, 13375), which would make any name-based match ambiguous; DEF-005 fixed 10/15.
cases.evidence: DEV data check 10/20 21:38 (uat_billadmin): 230 catalog items vs Tier 1 on 150 of 196 Rockefeller incidents

cases.pre: A Tier 1 value that matches more than one catalog item.

Save.
exp: Service SKU stays empty.

cases.actual: ACCEPTED AS KNOWN GAP - not executed (same decision as UT-A-03, N. Foy 10/20 21:40). No Rockefeller Tier 1 value matches any catalog Subcategory, so an ambiguous (2+) match cannot occur. Also, the expected results are superseded by DEF-064: NN:HPD:CGB_SKU_011_AmbiguousTier1 (order 1) only clears Service SKU and shows no message, and NN:HPD:CGB_SKU_016_DefaultSKU (order 1, runs after 011) would then set CGBDEFAULT - so the SKU would not stay empty and no 'matches more than one catalog item' message exists. If the Tier 1 mapping is ever revived, the ambiguous case needs a message action and must be decided against the CGBDEFAULT default.
cases.evidence: Same DEV data check as UT-A-03 (10/20 21:38); filter review of Checkpoint INCWO 102026

cases.title: Retiring a catalog item removes it from use
steps: Admin Console > Module: Service > select UAT-910 > Modify: set Retired = Yes and save.
Open a new Incident and open the Service SKU menu.
Set Retired = No on UAT-910 and save; open the Service SKU menu again.
exp: After step 1 the item Status = Inactive and Visible In Portal = No.

cases.actual: Catalog item UAT-910 Old Service created as nfoy_rf (SVC000000000304: Hourly, 50.00, 63719/54101, Status Active, Visible In Portal True). defects.title: Hourly Incident charge wrong when created in Smart IT (no server calculation on create); Details text missing hours
defects.desc: INC000000167334 (Smart IT, nfoy_rf, UAT Customer01, SKU UAT-901 Hourly $80, Time Worked = 50): Smart IT showed a Charge Amount preview of 300 before save and the record saved with Charge Amount 300.00 and Charge Amount_Details 'x 80 Hourly Rate = 300 Total'. Expected 60.00 (50 min - 15 free = 35, rounded up to 45 = 0.75 h x $80). The Incident hourly workflow in the build (NN:HPD:CGB_Incident_CalculateHourlyCharge active link and filter) computes TRUNC((Time Worked x 60 - 15 + 14) / 15) x 0.25 x Rate, i.e. it treats Time Worked (537888123) as HOURS: 50 would give 3,980.00 and 0.83 would give 60.00. 300.00 matches neither, so the value Smart IT shows and saves comes from somewhere else (Smart IT does not run classic active links, and the filter only recalculates on Modify when Time Worked changes). The Details text is also missing its first part (the hours). Smart IT also has a separate 'Minutes Worked' field (536870942) that no Incident chargeback workflow reads.
defects.work: Decision (N. Foy 10/16): technicians enter HOURS in Time Worked (537888123); Minutes Worked is not used. Fix imported 10/16 08:30: Rockefeller_CGB_HPD_HourlyCharge_Fix_101626.def (filter runs on Submit + Modify; Details starts with the hours). Verified INC000000167336 (Smart IT, Time Worked 0.83, UAT-901 $80): Charge Amount 60.00, Details '0.83 h x 80 Hourly Rate = 60 Total'. Smart IT showed no 300 preview this time. Clean-up: INC000000167334 still holds 300.00 (Time Worked 50) from before the fix.
